digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule enforcement
propositions: The codebase currently has 142 actionable RUF diagnostics (excluding RUF001-003 and RUF100) that must be remediated before enabling the RUF rule family in global configuration.

RUF linting rules must be added to the global Ruff configuration with only RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 permanently deferred in tool.ruff.lint.ignore, with no extend-ignore or per-file RUF exemptions allowed.
The ruff ratchet test must enforce that the configuration prohibits RUF rules from per-file-ignores and verify the exact deferral set.
After remediating the 142 diagnostics, stale RUF100 suppressions must be removed under the full configured rule set, not narrow-selection artifacts.
All remediation must be behavior-preserving and verified to produce zero RUF diagnostics across both the baseline command and the full ruff check.
